subject.title: refactor(auth): finish SQLite-only auth profile cutover

question: During the announced SDK compatibility window, must `AuthStorage.create(path)` and `FileAuthStorageBackend` preserve arbitrary legacy file-path semantics, or is support intentionally limited to paths that identify a normal OpenClaw agent directory?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes persistence from the caller-named JSON file to the agent database; only maintainers can set the supported external-plugin compatibility boundary for that deprecation.

options.title: Preserve broader path compatibility
options.body: Retain a SQLite adapter that preserves every previously supported path shape until the published-plugin reader sweep and removal date.

options.title: Narrow the deprecated contract
options.body: Document and enforce that the deprecated adapters only accept canonical agent auth paths, with a migration diagnostic for other callers.

recommendation.title: Preserve broader path compatibility
recommendation.body: Retain a SQLite adapter that preserves every previously supported path shape until the published-plugin reader sweep and removal date.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible proposal and compatibility-window design are authored by steipete, making them the best available routing candidate for the intended SDK boundary.
